items.name: docs-utils
items.title: Docs utilities
items.description: Shared helpers used by docscn components: URL matching, ref merging, hotkeys, copy-button state and tab groups that share a selection.

items.name: search-context
items.title: Search context
items.description: SearchProvider and useSearchContext: the search dialog's open state, its Meta/Ctrl+K hotkey and shared dialog types.

items.name: i18n-context
items.title: I18n context
items.description: I18nProvider and useI18n: the current locale, the available locales and the UI string translations, which RootProvider's i18n prop sets.

items.name: i18n
items.title: I18n
items.description: defineI18nUI, i18nProvider and uiTranslations: build RootProvider's i18n prop from a Fumadocs Core i18n config, with translations of the UI strings keyed as in Fumadocs UI.

items.name: root-provider
items.title: Root provider
items.description: RootProvider for the root layout: theme (next-themes) with a `d` hotkey, the default search dialog, tooltips, text direction and Next.js framework adapters.

items.name: theme-switch
items.title: Theme switch
items.description: ThemeSwitch: a light/dark toggle, or a light/dark/system toggle group.

items.name: search-trigger
items.title: Search trigger
items.description: SearchTrigger (icon button) and FullSearchTrigger (search field with hotkey hint) that open the search dialog.

items.name: language-select
items.title: Language select
items.description: LanguageSelect and LanguageSelectText: a popover listing the locales from RootProvider's i18n prop, shown by the layouts when there is more than one.

items.name: layout-shared
items.title: Shared layout options
items.description: BaseLayoutProps, link items, layout tabs, the AI chat panel and helpers shared by the docs, notebook and home layouts.

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: The docs-typeset class for MDX content, built from your shadcn/ui theme tokens. Add not-docs-typeset to opt an element out.

items.name: heading
items.title: Heading
items.description: Heading with an anchor link and a button that copies the link to the section.

items.name: codeblock
items.title: Code block
items.description: CodeBlock and CodeBlockTabs for Fumadocs MDX's Shiki output: title, icon, copy button, code tabs, and the styles for dual themes, highlights, diffs, focus and line numbers.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Cards and Card: a grid of link cards with an icon, title and description.

items.name: callout
items.title: Callout
items.description: Callout for notes and warnings, with info, warning, error, success and idea types.

items.name: mdx
items.title: MDX components
items.description: defaultMdxComponents for Fumadocs MDX content (code blocks, headings, links, images, tables, cards and callouts) and createRelativeLink.

items.name: tree-context
items.title: Page tree context
items.description: TreeContextProvider and hooks for the current page tree, the path to the current page, layout tab groups and the linear page list used for previous/next links.

items.name: docs-sidebar
items.title: Docs sidebar
items.description: SidebarPageTree renders a Fumadocs page tree (pages, folders, separators, icons, external links) with the shadcn/ui sidebar menu, and SidebarLinkItem renders layout links.

items.name: sidebar-tabs
items.title: Sidebar tabs
items.description: getSidebarTabs and SidebarTabsDropdown: switch between root folders of the page tree from a dropdown in the sidebar.

items.name: docs-layout
items.title: Docs layout
items.description: DocsLayout: the docs layout on the shadcn/ui sidebar, with the page tree, search, layout tabs, links, a theme switch and a mobile navbar.

items.name: toc
items.title: Table of contents
items.description: TOCProvider, TOCScrollArea and the TOC items in three styles: the default, with a thumb that follows the headings in view, clerk and block.

items.name: page-actions
items.title: Page actions
items.description: MarkdownCopyButton copies the page as Markdown, and ViewOptionsPopover links to the source on GitHub, the Markdown, and ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and Scira.

items.name: docs-page
items.title: Docs page
items.description: DocsPage, DocsTitle, DocsDescription and DocsBody, with the breadcrumb, previous/next links, the table of contents (a popover on small screens), EditOnGitHub and PageLastUpdate.

items.name: notebook-layout
items.title: Notebook layout
items.description: DocsLayout from layouts/notebook: a more compact docs layout on the shadcn/ui sidebar, with a navbar beside or above the sidebar, and layout tabs in the sidebar or the navbar.

items.name: notebook-page
items.title: Notebook page
items.description: DocsPage and the other page components from layouts/notebook/page, for pages in the notebook layout: the breadcrumb, previous/next links, the table of contents, EditOnGitHub and PageLastUpdate.

items.name: search-dialog
items.title: Search dialog
items.description: The search dialog's parts (SearchDialog, SearchDialogContent, SearchDialogInput, SearchDialogList, TagsList, ...) for building a search dialog for any Fumadocs search client, with highlighted matches and keyboard navigation.

items.name: search-dialog-default
items.title: Default search dialog
items.description: DefaultSearchDialog: the search dialog for Fumadocs' built-in search server (createFromSource), with tag filters and default links. RootProvider loads it by default.

items.name: home-layout
items.title: Home layout
items.description: HomeLayout: a layout for landing pages with a navbar (links, navigation menus, search, theme switch) and a mobile menu, plus DefaultNotFound for 404 pages.

items.name: og
items.title: OG image
items.description: generateOGImage: a default Open Graph image for docs pages, rendered with next/og.

items.name: docs-tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs and Tab for MDX content: tabs from a list of items or with explicit values, with selections shared between tab groups, persisted, or linked from the URL hash.

items.name: steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: Steps and Step: numbered steps on a line, plus the styles for the fd-steps and fd-step classes that remark-steps adds.

items.name: docs-accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Accordions and Accordion: collapsible sections that open from the URL hash and have a copy-link button.

items.name: files
items.title: Files
items.description: Files, Folder and File: a file tree with collapsible folders, also rendered from remark-mdx-files output.

items.name: type-table
items.title: Type table
items.description: TypeTable: a table of props or fields, each expanding to its description, full type, default, parameters and return value, and linkable from the URL hash.

items.name: image-zoom
items.title: Image zoom
items.description: ImageZoom: an image that zooms in to fill the screen when clicked, built on react-medium-image-zoom.

items.name: inline-toc
items.title: Inline TOC
items.description: InlineTOC: a collapsible table of contents to place inside a page.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: Banner: an announcement bar above the layout, optionally dismissible and with a rainbow variant, that offsets docscn's layouts by its height.

items.name: github-info
items.title: GitHub info
items.description: GithubInfo: a link to a GitHub repository with its star and fork counts, fetched on the server.

items.name: dynamic-codeblock
items.title: Dynamic code block
items.description: DynamicCodeBlock: a code block highlighted with Shiki in the browser, for code that's only known at runtime.

items.name: server-codeblock
items.title: Server code block
items.description: ServerCodeBlock: a code block highlighted with Shiki in a React Server Component.

items.name: ai-chat
items.title: AI chat
items.description: The AI chat UI for the layouts' aiChat option, built on the AI SDK: AIChatProvider, AIChatPanel, AIChatTrigger and AIChatSearch, with streamed Markdown answers and translated strings. Installs into components/ai/chat, where Fumadocs' CLI puts it.

items.name: docs
items.title: Docs
items.description: Docs for a new Next.js project: every docscn component, Fumadocs MDX content in content/docs, the /docs routes and a search API.
items.docs: Finish the setup with two edits. 1) In app/layout.tsx, import { RootProvider } from "@/components/docs/provider/next" and wrap {children} in <RootProvider>. RootProvider includes next-themes, so it replaces the ThemeProvider from shadcn/ui's template or dark mode guide. Keep suppressHydrationWarning on <html>. 2) In next.config.ts, import { createMDX } from "fumadocs-mdx/next" and change the export to export default createMDX()(nextConfig). Then start the dev server and open /docs. See https://docscn.dev/docs/getting-started.

items.name: ai-chat-openrouter
items.title: AI chat (OpenRouter)
items.description: Ask AI for your docs: the AI chat wired into DocsLayout, with a chat route that searches your pages and answers through OpenRouter.
items.docs: Finish the setup with two edits. 1) In app/docs/layout.tsx, import DocsLayout from "@/components/ai/layout" instead of "@/components/docs/layouts/docs". 2) Set OPENROUTER_API_KEY in .env.local (and optionally OPENROUTER_MODEL, which defaults to anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5). The chat route reads each page's processed Markdown, so lib/source.ts needs postprocess: { includeProcessedMarkdown: true } in its docs options, as the docs block sets it. See https://docscn.dev/docs/components/ai-chat.

items.name: fumadocs-ui
items.title: Fumadocs UI
items.description: Every docscn component, for migrating from Fumadocs UI: replace fumadocs-ui/ with @/components/docs/ in your imports.
